planets.name: LP 714-47 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LP 714-47 with a 4.05-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: LP 714-47 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around LP 714-47. Its orbit and size follow Serrano Bell et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
